CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]

Specimen Type: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Follow-up karyotype analysis requested after rapid aneuploidy PCR screening.

TEST PERFORMED
G-banded Chromosome Analysis

METHODOLOGY
Peripheral blood lymphocytes were cultured, harvested, and G-banded according to standard protocols. Twenty metaphase cells were analyzed at a resolution of 450-550 bands.

RESULT
Karyotype: 46,XX

Normal female karyotype. No evidence of trisomy 21 or other chromosomal abnormalities detected.

INTERPRETATION
This G-banded chromosome analysis confirms the preliminary rapid PCR result. The normal karyotype excludes Down syndrome (trisomy 21) and other major chromosomal abnormalities detectable at this level of resolution.

Note: This analysis can detect numerical abnormalities and structural rearrangements >5-10 Mb in size. Smaller deletions, duplications, or balanced rearrangements may not be detected by conventional karyotyping.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
